method: One ordinary public homepage fetch per publisher. Up to two real linked story URLs selected from headline elements or article-card headline structure. At most one ordinary fetch per selected supported article URL. Same reader User-Agent as current public reader. No cookies, browser, challenge bypass, provider calls, or retries after HTTP 402/403/challenge. Unsupported FT/Observer URLs are recorded from the homepage; article bodies were not fetched. Stored output contains metadata/counts only.
limitations: Homepage observation date is distinct from any article publication date.
Extraction passing does not establish full-text completeness, visual fidelity, media playback, or physical-phone behavior.
No browser was used; the final HTML browser opening and native sharing were not tested. Handler behavior is separately simulated in a DOM.
Daily Mail redirects from .com may be observed by the ordinary fetch; only the final response of each fetch call is recorded.

The initial record is preserved as frontpage-today-audit-initial.json. This follow-up made one ordinary homepage fetch each for Guardian, Standard, Independent, Times, Sun, and Observer only. Existing eight article responses were reused; new supported article URLs were fetched once. No retry to Telegraph or FT.
correction.methodCorrection: Story URL filter now excludes exact section landing paths and known author/tag/index routes while permitting article-category paths.
